set.body:
Build the common measurement-and-projection contract consumed by DL1-DL6 and the graph slices. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, section "Measurement and projection contract".
Each capability contributes versioned annotations, assessments or measurements with explicit support, provenance, missingness and uncertainty semantics. Shared derivations produce analysis views without changing the original evidence or repeating model extraction. Connect and extend the existing features tracks (measure.scala, space.scala, track.scala, window.scala), the align MeasureKind vocabulary and the recall-onset export; do not build a parallel module or result format.
Acceptance (engineering): from the same saved source, recall and mapping artifacts, produce (1) a recall-indexed feature table, with a recall-time matrix where timing and projection assumptions permit; (2) a sparse recall-source correspondence table preserving joint references, broad references, alternative hypotheses and unresolved outcomes; (3) a source-indexed participant summary with explicit coverage definitions, denominators and assessment status. Every output identifies its inputs and derivation policy; unsupported measurements remain explicitly unavailable. Independently calculated synthetic controls discriminate: "A and B" from "A or B"; a broad summary from explicit recall of each constituent; one atom referenced by several words; onset-only from duration-supported timing; an amount-conserving from a level-holding allocation.
Not in scope: scientific qualification of any measure (separate, per measure, interpretation and domain), HRF or FIR modelling beyond a documented downstream recipe, and new public types before the vocabulary ADR is decided.
Slice into day-sized beads when work starts (reference meanings in the correspondence record; projection declarations; the three exports).
set.title: [detail-mapping] Measurement-and-projection contract shared by DL1-DL6
